notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
[h3] The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. [/h3]

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with [b]Samudra + Mythic Ocean bundle[/b] and many other titles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png[/img]

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, [b]we're pledging 20% of our net profits to Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/b] and you get to purchase our games, Samudra + Mythic Ocean bundle included, at [i]deep[/i] discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟

[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]

 [h2][b]About Samudra + Mythic Ocean bundle[/b][/h2]

Explore the depths in this bundle!

In Mythic Ocean, experience a narrative adventure built around befriending the gods of the world and shaping the world through your relationship with them. Explore the world and shape it at your pace. There is no combat, so there is no death. Have conversations with the gods that can and will influence the way the world changes. The fate of the world is in your hands!

SAMUDRA is a deep-sea hand-illustrated adventure. Take part in a story designed to be told with no dialogue, accessible to all no matter the language. Discover the secrets of a terribly polluted ocean and the actions that led to its current state. Make the journey to the surface and survive the depths!

💦 So, are you ready to dive in? Support marine life and celebrate the ocean with Samudra + Mythic Ocean bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27758/SAMUDRA__Mythic_Ocean/

[h3]Fans of weird and interesting narrative games, join together in a digital space to hear news: Mythic Ocean is a part of LudoNarraCon - digital festival celebrating narrative games![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32337981/cb85b18c1f704e977c92847702cac2ef779bf856.png[/img]
[b]What is LudoNarraCon?[/b]

LudoNarraCon is a global, digital convention celebrating narrative video games, the talented people who make them, and the fans who love them, hosted on Steam. The inaugural LudoNarraCon took place in 2019. [b]In 2024, the event will return on May 9 - 13 2024[/b]. 

[b]Where did the name come from?[/b]
[i]ludo[/i]- Of or relating to games and play.
[i]ludonarrative[/i]- The intersection between gameplay and narrative elements. AKA, “where narrative meets play!”
[b]LudoNarraCon[/b]- A digital convention celebrating narrative video games, the people who make them, and the fans who enjoy them.

notes.title: A Sneak Peek at ATONE Combat and Music
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/38993a11746e685279592e53ebfab7d29aaa5bb9.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Midgardians![/h1]

[b]ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree[/b], the upcoming title from our friends at [b]Untold Tales[/b] and [b]Wildboy Studios[/b], launches in just 10 short days, so we wanted to provide a nice snippet of combat and a preview of the incredible soundtrack that awaits you. 

[h2]FIGHT TO THE BEAT[/h2]

Combat is all about surviving to the end of the song. Let's have a quick look at a battle against the Ice King in Hard Mode.

[previewyoutube=rv55TIzzBgs;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep focused and stick to the rhythm and you'll land a strike. But make too many mistakes and it'll cost you! 

If you find yourself struggling or unable to vanquish your enemies, there's always Normal Moe which makes the notes appear on 2 rails only. There is also Story Mode, where combat is entirely winnable, every time, allowing you to focus on the incredible narrative.

All fights can then be replayed in the Arena Mode for those wanting that perfect score or certain trophies.

[h2]A TASTE OF THE TUNES[/h2]

We've also got a little sneak peak at the amazing in-game OST, composed by the talented [b]James Shuar[/b] also know in the electronica scene as [b]Luminist[/b], as well as contributions from composer Andrew Prahlow ([b]The Outer Wilds[/b]). 

Have a listen to "Sons of Fenrir" and transport yourself to the wilds of ATONE.

[previewyoutube=ls_CZHd7p_M;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for reading!

♥️ It would be very helpful if you follow and wishlist the game below ♥️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620/ATONE_Heart_of_the_Elder_Tree/

notes.title: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree joins Untold Tales
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Three years ago, we launched our first ever title as a studio with [b]ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree[/b]. It was received with critical acclaim and won several awards, and we were so humbled by all the support and love for the unique Norse world we created.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/4005a0aa7ce0f645ef6de4804fc79f41f34448ac.png[/img]

Now, we have several announcements to share with you all! 

[h1]New Publisher[/h1]
First up, we're happy to share that we have an official publisher: [b]Untold Tales[/b]! They've been a great partner and will support us in all efforts to bring our game to you as smoothly as possible. So go on and give them a follow! -> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/untoldtales][/url]

[h1]Release Window[/h1]
Second, we're excited to confirm that we're targeting launch in [b]early 2023[/b]. We understand that it's not an exact date, but game development can fluctuate wildly and we don't want to promise something only to disappoint! AND, we'll also be launching on Nintendo Switch, so you can find us there if that's more your style.

[h1]Next Fest Demo Available Now[/h1]
Last but certainly not least, we have a free demo for you to try as part of Next Fest! That's right, it's available now. So keep that axe sharp, you'll need it! And when you're done playing, come back and give us your thoughts. We'd love to hear them!

notes.title: WDC World Oceans Day Charity Sale
notes.content:
[h1]WDC World Oceans Day Charity Sale [/h1]

We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Oceans Day!   
The WDC World Oceans Day Sale starts Wednesday, June 8th at 10am PDT and runs until June 13th, 10am PDT 2022, and you can save a fin-tastic 30% off Mythic Ocean. We will also donate 30% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.* 

WDC is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. WDC defends these remarkable creatures against the many threats they face by fighting to stop whaling, end captivity, prevent accidental entanglement and deaths in nets and create healthy seas. They also advocate for the vital role that whales and dolphins play in fighting climate change and keeping our planet healthy. Their vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.
If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: [url=https://uk.whales.org/]https://uk.whales.org/[/url]
You can find many other amazing games in the sale here: [url=https://bit.ly/OceansDaySteamSale]https://bit.ly/OceansDaySteamSale[/url]
Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! 

*30% of our net developer revenue from this sale will support Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 Notes
notes.content:
We've uploaded a patch which addresses some minor issues with the game.

[list]
[*] Added Teleporter controls legend to the pause menu
[*] Fixed a typo in Elil's dialog
[*] Fixed a small hole in Elil's model
[*] Fixed a bug where a Zooid could be spawned clipping into another
[*] Fixed a volume issue with Paradise Reconsidered song
[*] Added a Credits button to the main menu
[/list]
